Every service under services/ inherits each value it does not state itself from defaults.yaml. For every service, report its effective CPU limit, where that value comes from, and the policy it uses with that policy's priority.

Answer as one line per service, alphabetically by service name, and nothing else:

name=<service> cpu=<value> source=<override|default> policy=<name> priority=<n>

name=api cpu=500m source=override policy=shared-a priority=10
name=auth cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10
name=billing cpu=1000m source=override policy=shared-b priority=20
name=cache cpu=200m source=override policy=shared-a priority=10
name=cdn cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-b priority=20
name=docs cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10
name=events cpu=750m source=override policy=shared-b priority=20
name=gateway cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10
name=invoicing cpu=1500m source=override policy=shared-c priority=30
name=jobs cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-c priority=30
name=ledger cpu=300m source=override policy=shared-b priority=20
name=metrics cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10

Now add whether each service is disabled, keeping the same order and every earlier field:

name=<service> cpu=<value> source=<override|default> policy=<name> priority=<n> disabled=<true|false>

Nothing else.

name=api cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10 disabled=false
name=auth cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10 disabled=false
name=billing cpu=1000m source=override policy=shared-b priority=20 disabled=true
name=cache cpu=200m source=override policy=shared-a priority=10 disabled=false
name=cdn cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-b priority=20 disabled=true
name=docs cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10 disabled=false
name=events cpu=750m source=override policy=shared-b priority=20 disabled=false
name=gateway cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10 disabled=false
name=invoicing cpu=1500m source=override policy=shared-c priority=30 disabled=true
name=jobs cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-c priority=30 disabled=false
name=ledger cpu=300m source=override policy=shared-b priority=20 disabled=false
name=metrics cpu=250m source=default policy=shared-a priority=10 disabled=true
